g.text: A companion app, a small computer on the walker and a gateway designed to find it, hear it
and stop it — using the walker you already own.
A quick-release mount fits common tube diameters.
Locator lights, voice and a simple FIND action.
The software prototype is real; field behaviour is a separate gate.
Target hardware sheet · not physical-use evidence
Attach the device without replacing the frame.
Connect the owner PWA over Wi-Fi or BLE.
Light, speak and locate from the phone.
Brake the walker through the gateway.
